scope: Schema3 real 0.2 versus schema4 real 0.3; developer simulation, no human play or enjoyment claim. Four fixed visible-information policies; geometry uses optional complete auto-arrange. Net cash includes actual tool purchases, services and sales in each voyage; no debt repayments are made. No old-cargo replacement policy; replacements=0 by construction. Counts of declined loot refer to proposed choices, not distinct physical items. No price/fuel tuning. Both models use real geometry. Splitting value into small pieces changes top-item trades; policy paths may diverge. Declined loot choices count opportunities, not destroyed inventory; no physical discards by this policy.
